# #4931: Patch: screen the reply's open-lethal switch again on today's reply
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the practice AI imagines the opponent's answer to its plans, the imagined opponent scores its attacks one hit at a time and never notices it could win on the spot, even with lethal on board. A switch (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal`) makes the imagined opponent take the win when it sees one: every remaining attack on the hero counts as the win, so the face goes first and no attacker is wasted on a kill. It has always been off. Turning it on would make the AI respect real counter-lethal: lines that walk into a killing board score worse, lines that hold back a Taunt or keep health score better, and the practice opponent defends itself like a player who sees the win.

## Why

SPEC §9.9 (`spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`, The opponent's reply) ends the lethal paragraph with: this is switched off (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal`) until a screen keeps it. The spec invites exactly this screen. The switch was screened twice on older replies and kept off both times for lack of evidence, not for harm: #1634's screen read 203-197, edge +0.015 (-0.002 to +0.032), inconclusive with 3 decided of 200 (won 3, lost 0); #4246's read 200-200, edge 0.0, inconclusive with 0 decided of 200 (`crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` comment). But the reply those screens measured is not today's reply. Since #4246 the reply gained spread Activates that reach every lane (R4515000), walls against lethal (R4187000), close steps that end open turns (R4810000), First-Strike-exiled attackers worth nothing (R4171000), damage pools and conversions (R4064000, R4064001), GIGA-aware Cleave (R4257000), strike-back and Frenzy handling (R4402000), Lifesteal face value, and cleanup-discard comparison (R3696001). Walls (R4187000) in particular interact directly with whether the reply takes lethal, so an inconclusive read on that reply does not settle the switch on this one. No open issue covers it and it is none of the rejected suggestions.

## Proposal

Flip `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` to true behind one 400-game deal screen on improve-dev against a control built from the tip (`training/improve.md`, A screen), size decided in advance; keep only if `edgeLow` is above 0, else revert and record the screen in the config comment. Pin the new reply behavior with scene tests (reply with lethal on board attacks the hero first and spends nothing on kills; a non-lethal reply is unchanged). If inconclusive a third time, leave it off with no further screen until the reply itself changes again.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal` and its screen comment)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` (scene tests for the lethal reply)
- `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md` (one line, only if the screen keeps it: off-until-a-screen-keeps-it becomes on-since-the-screen)
- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (read-only: `simulate_reply_with` already threads the switch, `reply.rs:912-999`)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Control built from the committed tip before any change; 400 games on improve-dev, candidate versus control, with the tally recorded (wins, edge with interval, decided wonBoth-lostBoth, diverged) in the config comment and the issue.
- [ ] Kept only if `edgeLow` is above 0; otherwise reverted, screen recorded, switch stays off.
- [ ] Scene tests fail without the flip (reply does not take a showing lethal) and pass with it.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` green; `cargo jackioh gate` smoke green.
- [ ] No other constant touched; no screen repeated or extended after the read.

## Size and risks

Small code change (one constant plus tests); medium time (400 games, roughly 25-45 minutes on two cores, fits a bot run per `training/improve.md`). Main risk is a third inconclusive screen that settles nothing; contained by fixing the size in advance, keeping only on `edgeLow > 0`, and stopping after one screen.

## Files to touch

| File | Status | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Flip `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` to `true` (if kept) or keep `false` (if reverted), and record the screen tally in the doc comment above it |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` | change | If kept: pin scene tests in `mod open_lethal_1634` so they assert the lethal reply takes the hero directly and non-lethal is unchanged (failing without the flip, passing with it); if reverted: keep matching `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` |
| `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md` | change | If kept: update §9.9 "The opponent's reply" line 20 from "switched off ... until a screen keeps it" to "switched on ... since #4931's screen"; untouched if reverted |

Spec sections and rulings governing the change: SPEC §9.9 (`spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`, "The opponent's reply"), `training/improve.md` ("A screen"), R850000, R850001, R4319000, #1634, R4187000.

## Steps

1. **Build the control binary from the tip.**
   Before making any edits in the worktree, build the release `jackioh-tools` CLI binary from the committed HEAD (`12f393b679225f1743a67b299d5007ca440d6530`):
   ```sh
   cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh ~/control-jackioh
   ```
   Verify the control binary runs:
   ```sh
   ~/control-jackioh --version
   ```

2. **Flip `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` in candidate.**
   In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, under `pub const AI_REPLY: AiReply`, change:
   ```rust
   open_lethal: false,
   ```
   to:
   ```rust
   open_lethal: true,
   ```

3. **Run the 400-game deal screen.**
   Run the deal screen on `improve-dev` against the control binary:
   ```sh
   cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:~/control-jackioh --set improve-dev
   ```
   This runs 400 games (200 paired deals, swapping p1/p2 seats).
   Wait for completion and record the summary output:
   - Matchup score: wins for candidate (`a`) vs control (`b`) (e.g. `200-200`)
   - `edge` and 95% interval: `edgeLow` to `edgeHigh`
   - `decided`: `wonBoth` - `lostBoth`
   - `diverged`: number of deals diverged
   - `inconclusive: true` flag if `decided < 20` (R4319000)

4. **Evaluate screen outcome.**
   - **Case A: `edgeLow > 0.0` (Kept):**
     1. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, keep `open_lethal: true,` and update the doc comment preceding it to record the #4931 screen:
        ```rust
        // #1634: off. On, its screen read 203-197, edge 0.015 (-0.002 to 0.032), inconclusive (R4319000):
        // 3 decided of 200 (won 3, lost 0). #4246's, on the reply as it stands since, 400 games on
        // improve-dev against the control at baa7cdb93f, read 200-200, edge 0.0 (0.0 to 0.0), inconclusive
        // (R4319000): 0 decided of 200, 21 diverged. #4931's, 400 games on improve-dev against the
        // control at 12f393b679, read <W>-<L>, edge <edge> (<edgeLow> to <edgeHigh>), <decided> decided
        // of 200 (<wonBoth>-<lostBoth>), <diverged> diverged: kept (training/improve.md, A screen).
        open_lethal: true,
        ```
     2. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` under `mod open_lethal_1634`:
        - In `fn b41_takes_a_lethal_that_needs_both_attacks_over_a_kill_worth_more_than_one_hit`:
          Replace `assert_eq!(shipped.result.is_some(), AI_REPLY.open_lethal);` with:
          ```rust
          assert!(shipped.result.is_some());
          assert_eq!(shipped.result.map(|result| result.winner), Some(Winner::from(HUMAN)));
          assert!(on_field(&shipped, AI, "core-008"));
          ```
        - In `fn decide_blocks_one_of_two_attackers_that_are_lethal_only_together`:
          Replace `assert_eq!(survives, AI_REPLY.open_lethal, "{}", trace(&run.turn));` with:
          ```rust
          assert!(survives, "{}", trace(&run.turn));
          ```
        - Add a scene test in `mod open_lethal_1634` asserting that a non-lethal board (e.g. p1 at 20 health with core-008 vs two core-025 7/7s) remains unchanged (reply kills core-008 and attacks face once for 7, leaving p1 at 13 health).
     3. In `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`, update line 20 under "The opponent's reply":
        Replace:
        `This is switched off (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal`) until a screen keeps it.`
        with:
        `This is switched on (`AI_REPLY.open_lethal`) since #4931's screen.`

   - **Case B: `edgeLow <= 0.0` (Reverted / Inconclusive):**
     1. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, revert `open_lethal` to `false,` and update the doc comment preceding it:
        ```rust
        // #1634: off. On, its screen read 203-197, edge 0.015 (-0.002 to 0.032), inconclusive (R4319000):
        // 3 decided of 200 (won 3, lost 0). #4246's, on the reply as it stands since, 400 games on
        // improve-dev against the control at baa7cdb93f, read 200-200, edge 0.0 (0.0 to 0.0), inconclusive
        // (R4319000): 0 decided of 200, 21 diverged. #4931's, 400 games on improve-dev against the
        // control at 12f393b679, read <W>-<L>, edge <edge> (<edgeLow> to <edgeHigh>), inconclusive
        // (R4319000): <decided> decided of 200 (<wonBoth>-<lostBoth>), <diverged> diverged. Left off
        // with no further screen until the reply changes again (training/improve.md, A screen).
        open_lethal: false,
        ```
     2. Leave `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md` unchanged.
     3. Keep `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` matching `AI_REPLY.open_lethal` (tests pass with `open_lethal: false`).

5. **Clean up and run local verification.**
   Remove `~/control-jackioh`.
   Run:
   ```sh
   cargo test -p jackioh-ai open_lethal_1634
   cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo fmt --check
   cargo jackioh gate
   ```

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs`:
  - `open_lethal_1634::b41_takes_a_lethal_that_needs_both_attacks_over_a_kill_worth_more_than_one_hit`: verifies that when `open_lethal` is active, `simulate_reply` executes lethal against the hero rather than spending an attack on a unit trade.
  - `open_lethal_1634::decide_blocks_one_of_two_attackers_that_are_lethal_only_together`: verifies the AI respects counter-lethal by walling with Defense Position.
  - Non-lethal scene test: verifies that when total power does not reach lethal, the reply behavior is identical to before.
  - Commands:
    ```sh
    cargo test -p jackioh-ai open_lethal_1634
    cargo test -p jackioh-ai
    ```

## Done when

- [ ] Control binary built from committed tip (`12f393b679`) before candidate changes.
- [ ] 400-game paired deal screen run on `improve-dev` candidate vs control.
- [ ] Tally recorded in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` doc comment (and pull request description).
- [ ] Switch kept (`open_lethal: true`) only if `edgeLow > 0.0`; otherwise reverted to `false`.
- [ ] If kept, scene tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` pin lethal reply taking face directly (failing if switch is false, passing if true), and `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md` updated.
- [ ] If reverted, spec is untouched and existing tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` clean.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` smoke green.
- [ ] Temporary `~/control-jackioh` removed; no other files modified.

## Risks

- **Screen time and resources:** 400 arena games take ~25-45 minutes. A single fixed-size run is performed with no extension or repeated screen, honoring R850001 and `training/improve.md`.
- **Inconclusive third screen:** If the screen yields fewer than 20 decided games or `edgeLow <= 0`, the issue explicitly dictates leaving `open_lethal: false` without further screens. The builder must not speculate or keep the change without positive `edgeLow`.
- **Purity and determinism:** Arena games use fixed seeds on `improve-dev`. No non-deterministic state, clocks, or I/O are introduced into `crates/ai/`.

## Open questions

None. The issue criteria, spec section, and screen thresholds are fully specified.
